name: Voxel Buffer Memory Layout and Loop Optimization
aliases: Cache-Optimized Voxel Access, Dense Field Implementation
definition: A dense voxel buffer is implemented as a contiguous 1D array (e.g., std::vector) where 3D coordinates (i, j, k) map to a 1D index using row-major ordering (x is innermost).
summary: Voxel Buffer Memory Layout and Loop Optimization aligns traversal loops with row-major memory strides to minimize cache misses in dense 3D voxel grids, distinguishing itself from bank conflict or attribute interleaving methods.
